set.body:
No test anywhere asserts what happens when a shorthand and its options-list
entry disagree, which is why the three precedence defects went unnoticed.

Add, for every shorthand/list pair:
  - the documented precedence is the observed precedence
  - a conflict is signalled, not silently resolved
  - fmri_lm_control() rejects unknown keys

The last one currently fails: modifyList has no whitelist
(R/fmri_lm_config.R:96, :125), so ar_options=list(struct="ar1", typo_key=99) is
accepted and typo_key survives into the config.
set.title: Tests: shorthand-vs-list precedence is untested
